简介: Ella Rumpf is a Swiss actress, best known for her role as Alexia in the 2016 horror drama film Raw, the film won 2016 Sutherland Award for most original and imaginative first feature at the London Film Festival. Her other notable roles include, critical acclaimed Tiger in Tiger Girl and Hanna in The Divine Order, the Swiss entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 90th Academy Awards.
